content: Betesda-dii-dikarba dule-geg-nanamaid nudaklesad
We-ibmar-degigusad-sorbali, Judíoʼmar-iba nagunonikid. Agi Jesús Jerusalénʼse nonikid.
Jerusalénʼgi, Sibad-Wawaadye-Yawagak-nugad-naba, dii wilasar naid. A-dii-wilasar-naidi, Hebreo-gayaba Betesdaʼye bileged. A-dii-naid-ebiris doged-imba gwaatar siid.
A-neg-doged-imbamargi bukidar bonikwamalad mamaid, ibyasurmalad, geg-nanamalad, bela-abagan-burgwarmalad, mamaid. Amar dii-sukamaked edarbe mamaimalad.
Ar ade, imbagwenar baliwitur, dii-wilasar-naid-osukamakega aidenonidaed. Ar doa-dule-inse a-dii-wilasar-naid-sukamaksad-sorba diigi-aidesale, ibi-boni-nikadibe, yog-nuguar naddaed.
Agine, dule-wargwen birga-dulagwen-gakambe-gakabaabakgus-uellemaid (38) maimogad.
Jesús a-dule meremai dakalid. Jesús wisguargu, we-dule dikasurgus boni-abgan-burgwaled-nikamaiye, a-dulega sogded: —¿Be nugubie?
Dule-abagan-burgwaled abin-sogded: —Dummad, dii-sukamaksad-sorba dule-diise-an-odeged sate daed. Ar an aidedogu, bato dule-baid an-iduar aidesdaed.
Jesús ega sogded: —Be gwisgu, be-egi-gabed na be sede, be nae.
Jesús-degisogsad-sorba, dule yog-nuguar naded, e-gabed na susa nadsunnad. A-ibagi, deun obunnoged-iba naid.
Agi Judíoʼmar dule-nugusadga sogdemalad: —Emi-ibagi obunnoged-iba naid. Degisoggu, be-egi-gabed be sededsulid.
Dule-nugusad, abin-sogded: —Dule-an-nudaksad, ar anga sogsad: ‘Be-egi-gabed be sedye, be naye.’
Degi, dule-nugusadse egisdemarsunnad: —¿Ar doa bega sogsa, Be-egi-gabed be sedye, be naye?
Ar Jesúsʼde bato dulemar-bukidar-gunanaid-abargi banguded. Degisoggu, ar dule-nugusad, wissulid, doa ega deyob sogsa.
A-sorbali, Jesús, dule-nugusad Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-dakargu, ega sogded: —Emide be nugussoggu, mer be bar isguo. Abakalegi aka bur bule boni-dummad begi danikile.
Dule-nugusad nadegusad, geb Judíoʼmar-owisodapid, Jesús e-onudaksaye.
A-ulale, Judíoʼmar Jesús-bareginnarmarsunnad, Jesús-oburgwebi guarmalad. Ar ade, obunnoged-ibagi we-ibmarmar imakdiid.
Degi, Jesús abin-sogded: —An-Bab gusgu arbanaiguad, degisoggu, an arbadimosundo.
A-ulale, Judíoʼmar bur Jesús-oburgwebi guarmalad, ar ade, Jesús obunnoged-ibabi bisgedisulid. Ar Bab-Dummad an-Bab-sunnadye sogdibalid. Deyob sogdiidbali na Bab-Dummadbo emar imakdiid.
Bab-Machi burba-geg-bergued-ukega gangued nikad

Geb degi, Jesús Judíoʼmarga sogded: —Napira an bemarga soged, Bab-Dummad-Machi wargwengi e-ibmar-imakbiedba ibmar imaksulid, unnila e-Bab-dakedba ibmar imaked. Ar bela e-Bab-ibmar-imakedi, E-Machi a-sunnaa bela ibmar imakmogad.
Ar Bab na Machi-sabsoggu, bela ibmar-imakedi E-Machiga oyoged. Ar weba bur bule ibmar-dummagan Bab ega oyogoed, adi, bemar bur bule geger dakmalagar.
Ar igi Bab dule-burgwar-maid gannar oduloge, ega san-burba-dula-gued uke, amba E-Machi deyobmodo, ar doaga san-burba-dulad ukbie, ega ukodo.
Ar emigi Bab bar dulemarga igar itogosulid. Ar ade, E-Machiga we-igargan uksad,
adi, igi E-Bab-nug ogannodamarmoga, deyobi bela dulemar E-Machi-nug ogannomogagar. Ar dule E-Machi-nug odummosulile, E-Bab-nug odummosurmogad. Ar ade, Bab na E-Machi barmialid.

”Napira an bemarga soged: Ar dule an-sunmakedba daele, degi, Bab-an-barmialidgi bengusulile, a-dule burba-geg-bergued nikuodo. A-dule bar sabsur-odurdaklegosulid. Ar burgwar-gudiidgi nosad, dula gudii gunonisunnad.
Napira an bemarga soged: Ibagan danikoed, emigindi, ibagan nonisunnad. Dule-burbar-burgwar-gudimalad Bab-Dummad-Machi-e-gayaburba itononikoed. Ar dule-a-gayaburba-itomaloedi durgunonikoed.
Ar igi Bab na-dukin dula-gudigued-nika, amba deyob, na E-Machiga na-dukin dulagudigued uksamogad.
Deginbali, ar Dule-Machi-gusoggu, Bab ega dulemarga-igar-itogega igar uksabalid.
”We-igar mer geger be itomar. Ar ibagan danikoed, dulemar-neg-uangi-burgwar-mamaidi, bela Bab-Dummad-Machi-e-gayaburba itomaloed.
Ar dule-ibmar-nued-imaksamaladi, burba-dulad-nikuega gannar durgunonimaloed. Ar dule-ibmar-isgana-imaksamaladdi, odurdakleged-negse-naega gannar durgunonimarmogoed.”
Jesús, Bab-Dummad-Machi-sunnadid

Jesús Judíoʼmarga sogdebalid: “Geg an na dukin wargwengi ibmar imaked, unnila an-Bab-anga-sogedba an dulemarga igar itoged. An-igar-itogedi, innikigwadgi an itoged. Ar wargwen an-itolegedba an ibmar imaksulid, an-ibmar-imakedi, an-Bab-an-barmialid-sogedba an imaked.
”Ar an na dukin ibmar barsogele, an-ibmar-sogedi napiragwadsuliled.
Emigindi, dule-baid an-barsoged, a-ular, an wisid, dule-an-barsoged napiragwadba an-barsogdiid.
”Bemar, Diigi-dule-oged-Juanʼse dulemar-barmiargusad, egisega, be Mesías-sogeye. Juan dulemar-abin-imaksagu, napiragwadgi sogsagusad.
Ar dule-we-napneggined an-barsogega an abingasulid. Degi-inigwele, bemar-abonolemalaga Juan-ibmar-sogsad an bemarga sogmalad.
Ar igi acha-gwallu gummake, degine, mee-gae, deyobi, Juan gudigusad. Ar bemar unnila a-gwallugine wis-ichesaar yeer-itodii abesmalad.

”Ar Juan-an-barsogdigusadba bur bule an na dukin ibmar-barsoged nikad, an doa-dule gue. We, an-barsogedid: Ibmar-imakega Bab arbaed anga igar-uksad. We-ibmar-an-imakdiidi bato oyonaid, Bab an-barmiarye.
Bab-an-barmialidi, bato angi sunmaksa gusad. Bemala bipisaale e-gaya-sunmaked be itodisurmalad, degine, e-dakleged be dakdisurmarbalid.
Deginbali, E-gayaburba bemargi gwen naisurbalid. Ar ade, bemar Bab-bemarse-dule-barmialidi, be a-dule benmalad.
Bab-Dummad-garda-narmakar-maid nue be baramimar, ar agi burba-geg-bergued baramilesiye, be sogmalad. Ar a-gardagi angi sunmaknaid, an doa-dule gue.
Degi-inigwele, bemar burba-geg-bergued-nikuega anse yapa dagmalad.
”Dulemar-an-nug-odummoged, an abingasulid.
Ar an bemar-wisid, bemar, Bab-Dummad-sabsurmalad.
An-Bab-nuggi an bemarse nonikid, degite, be an-abingasurmalad. Ar dule-baid na e-nuggi danikirdi, be a-dule abingasmalaled.
¿Ar igi bemar Bab-Dummad-bensuli gumalosunna? An na be muchub-muchub-san-ogannoed amidimalad. Ar Bab-Dummad-wargwenna-guedgi nug-gangued-danikiddi, bemar amisurmalad.
”Mer be binsamalo, ani an-Bab-asabin bemargi gwisgumaloye. Suli. Moisésʼgi be bendaklegoye binsadimaladi, a-dule, bemargi gwisgumaloed.
Ar Moisés-ibmar-sogsad be bensurmalana, be an-bensurmarmogando. Ar Moisés angi ibmar narmaksad.
Ar Moisés-ibmar-narmaksad be benmalale, degite, ¿igi an-ibmar-sogedgi be bensuli gumalosunna? Geg gued.”
